the
petitioner is entitled to any one or more of the reliefs which
he has prayed for, then the Court shall make-

(a) 
an  order  nisi,  conditioned  to  take  effect,  in  the
event the respondent does not show cause against
it, on a day specified by the order; or

(b) 
an  interlocutory  order  specifying  a  day  for  the
determination  of  the  matter  of  the  petition,  and
intimating  that  the  respondent  will  be  heard  in
opposition to the petition if he appears before the
Court for that purpose on the day so specified.
(2)    The  date  referred  to  in  paragraphs  (a)  and  (b)  of
subsection (1) shall be a date not more than fourteen days
from the date of delivery of the relevant order.
